name: Matniuel
note: Back-of-shirt sponsor of Manu Samoa's 2026 home jersey (script logo 'Matniuel Est 2011' below the number). Matniuel is a screen-printing and signage business in Apia (Sogi, Mulinu'u Rd), est. 2011 (instagram.com/matniuel.2011), also a listed sponsor on lakapisamoa.com/sponsors (logo 'matniuel.png'). Ownership not identified: Samoa's company register is not publicly searchable online and the company publishes no ownership information, so no ownership claim could be sourced.
